text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
An occasional day off is quite pleasant. 
We still have time to spare—what shall we 
do?
choice_data_list: Let's see, next we could—
Well then, next up is—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: ...Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No—that person walking over there. 
I couldn't help but take notice.

text_block_list.name: Distressed Woman
text_block_list.text:
*Pant, pant*... 
Ah... Oh no, I'm out of time...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. ...Forgive my intrusion, 
but have you injured your leg?

text_block_list.name: Distressed Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ah, w-well, I sprained my ankle... 
B-But I'm okay! I have to hurry to the 
station, so—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
All the more reason to be careful if you 
are in haste. 
Please, allow me to carry you on my back.

text_block_list.name: Distressed Woman
text_block_list.text:
What?!? 
I couldn't possibly ask that of you—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. Our legs exist for 
times 
like these as well. Do not hesitate.
choice_data_list: I'll carry your bags.
I'll carry your bags for you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Much obliged. Now, let us be off.

text_block_list.name: Distressed Woman
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so very much...! 
I made it in time for my bus...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful. Making it in time is a 
blessing, 
but please, do take care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Distressed Woman
text_block_list.text: I-Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No, it is nothing. 
Now then, we shall take our leave.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Now then. Shall we be on our way?
choice_data_list: ...Aren't you running a bit of a fever?
...Aren't you running a bit of a fever?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —It is... nothing serious.
choice_data_list: , let's rest.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I told you, it is nothing serious... 
I simply do not wish to impose upon your 
time.
choice_data_list:
There's no need to push yourself, not in 
front of me.

There's no need to push yourself, not in 
front of me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It seems I have no choice but to 
surrender.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lending her my shoulder, we made our way 
to a nearby park, 
where I had her lie down to rest.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —You are strong.
choice_data_list: Strong?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. One who is capable of kindness 
possesses both 
the wisdom to see into another's heart and 
stand by them, 
and the strength to reach out a helping 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Thus, someone like you is whom I call 
truly wise 
and strong. ...Does that sound like 
strange logic?
choice_data_list:
(...If you put it that way, you're the one 
who...)

(...If you put it that way, you're the one 
who...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Truly, I am much better now. 
I cannot impose on you forever. Please, 
let me down.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
My, you have a curious look on your face. 
What is the matter?
choice_data_list: , some words came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“I shall surely become a pine enduring a 
hundred years, 
should you but bestow upon me your guiding 
hand.”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—So, you based that upon the poem I once 
composed.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Just as the girls of the Club 
reside within my heart... 
Am I to believe that I also reside within 
yours?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
As a cornerstone for you to stay strong. 
............

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Then allow me to offer a poem in 
reply.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
“As this pine grows ever grander with the 
passing seasons, 
even my own heart swells with bold 
resolve.”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Hardly anyone can truly become strong 
entirely alone. 
It is only possible because others are 
there for us.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
When you teach and give to someone, and 
they receive it 
truly in earnest—the giver receives 
something far more 
irreplaceable within their own heart.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Finding a home within each other's 
hearts... 
Do you know what such a bond is called?
choice_data_list: That would be—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Family.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. There may be various rituals to 
become family, 
but in truth... it seems to simply be 
something 
you realize you have become before you 
know it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And—once you do, 
that bond shall surely never unravel.
choice_data_list:
As your pupil, I'll keep following in your 
footsteps.

I'd love to see that kind of bond spread 
further and further.

I'd love to see that kind of bond spread 
further and further.

I want to be someone who can give a lot to 
others too.

I want to be someone who can give a lot to 
others too.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And—once you do, 
that bond shall surely never unravel.
choice_data_list:
As your pupil, I'll keep following in your 
footsteps.

I'd love to see that kind of bond spread 
further and further.

I'd love to see that kind of bond spread 
further and further.

I want to be someone who can give a lot to 
others too.

I want to be someone who can give a lot to 
others too.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, how earnest of you. 
I am deeply grateful for that sentiment as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
For seeing you like this grants me 
a feeling far richer 
than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. For us, the very first step would 
naturally be... to win.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To take our family, the Club, to even 
greater heights. 
And from there, we shall welcome new 
family into our fold.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Let us take each other's hands and walk 
together all the way there.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You already are. 
You simply haven't realized it, 
but you are to so many around you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
However, should the day ever come 
when you forget that... 
—I shall remind you myself.
